say:1:1533009001:1.text: Oh, yes! I can't wait any longer. I've to open it right now! I need to smell it!
say:1:1533009001:1.source_cn: 终于到货了！不行，忍不住了，我现在就要拆开……哪怕只是...

narration:2:1533009002:0.text: With deft movements, Nodius unpicks the wrapping. A moment of tension hangs in the air as you peer inside... revealing nothing but a simple can of fish.
narration:2:1533009002:0.source_cn: 诺杜斯飞快地解开了包裹。在你警惕的目光中，你看到了……...

say:3:1533009003:0.text: Behold! "Funky Fish!" This is the extra stinky flavor! This is exactly what I ordered!
say:3:1533009003:0.source_cn: “奇臭鱼罐头——加量加臭版”！没错，这就是我订的货！
